text: Or, to bee quite cut off. Hebr. for cutting off.
Hebr. his hand hath attained, and found sufficiencie.
Or, one of the Leuites redeeme them.
Hebr. his hand faileth , Hebr. strengthen.
Exo.21.2. deut.15.12 ierem.34. 14. , Heb. serue thy selfe with him with the seruice, &c.
Hebr. with the sale of a bondman.
Hebr. ye shall serue your selues with them.
